outcome: genome-wide DNA methylation in cord tissue
genome-wide DNA methylation in cord blood
cohort: The cohort consisted of 295 neonates whose DNA methylation was profiled using Infinium HumanMethylation450 beadchip arrays.
finding: Neonatal epigenome-wide association study (EWAS) results and the inter-relationship between genetics, prenatal factors, and epigenetics were found to be tissue-specific, with cord tissue showing higher inter-individual variability and distinct phenotypic associations compared to cord blood.
